The '''V-N6 Exterminator Droid''' was a type of three-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] utilized by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. At least one was stationed aboard the [[Justice (Harrower-class)|''Justice'']], and was defeated by [[Havoc Squad]].
